title: Ground-Wing: A Parametric 3D Wing-in-Ground-Effect Dataset for Benchmarking Neural Surrogate Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.04571v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a CFD dataset of a highly parametrized 3D wing operating in ground effect, designed for benchmarking neural surrogate models for aerodynamic prediction, using a wing shape and flow conditions typically encountered in motorsport applications. The dataset comprises 770 RANS simulations of 194 unique wing configurations, sampled across 27 airfoil profile variants and 4 distances from the ground, spanning variations in wing sweep, chord, taper, angle of attack, and tip twist. Six neural network architectures representing distinct paradigms --- convolutional (DoMINO), graph-based (X-MeshGraphNet), transformer-based (AB-UPT, GeoTransolver, GAOT), and JEPA-based (AeroJEPA) --- are evaluated on their ability to predict surface pressure coefficient and wall shear stress distributions, from which integral drag and lift coefficients are recovered. The dataset is intended to be used as a challenging benchmark for surrogate CF

translated_title: Ground-Wing：用于基准测试神经代理模型的参数化三维地面效应机翼数据集
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个处于地面效应中运行的高度参数化三维机翼的CFD数据集，旨在为空气动力学预测的神经代理模型提供基准测试，其中采用的机翼形状和流动条件是赛车运动应用中典型的情况。该数据集包含194种独特机翼构型的770次RANS模拟，采样涵盖27种翼型变体和4个离地距离，并包含机翼后掠角、弦长、梯形比、迎角和翼尖扭转的变化。论文评估了六种代表不同范式的神经网络架构——卷积型（DoMINO）、基于图的（X-MeshGraphNet）、基于Transformer的（AB-UPT、GeoTransolver、GAOT）以及基于JEPA的（AeroJEPA）——预测表面压力系数和壁面剪应力分布的能力，并从中恢复积分阻力与升力系数。该数据集旨在作为神经代理CFD模型的一个具有挑战性的基准测试。
tldr: 本文发布了面向赛车地面效应机翼的高度参数化CFD数据集（194种构型、770次RANS模拟），并系统评估了六种不同范式的神经代理模型在预测表面压力、壁面剪应力及升阻力系数方面的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Ground-Wing, a highly parametric CFD dataset of 194 unique wing-in-ground-effect configurations (770 RANS simulations) that serves as a challenging benchmark for evaluating six neural surrogate model paradigms for aerodynamic prediction.
